name: velero_backup_stale
row_template: Schedule: {schedule} | seconds since last success (1 = none in 26h): {value}
description: No successful velero backup of schedule pvcs in 26h, or none ever. The last-success gauge only exists after a fully successful backup (PartiallyFailed never writes it; velero re-derives it from existing Completed backups on every resync/restart, so it drops only when no Completed backup of the schedule exists), so the absent_over_time arm covers never-succeeded, every-night-PartiallyFailed and BSL-Unavailable states (cmdshift/platform#231). Check: kubectl -n backups get backups.velero.io. After a rebuild it fires until the first success; velero backup create --from-schedule pvcs clears it. Runbook: velero-backups.md
